title: Resolved pin whose revision is not a full SHA
description: Package.resolved declares a pin whose revision is shorter than 40 hex characters. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a pin whose revision is shorter than 40 hex characters.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a pin whose revision is shorter than 40 hex characters.
limitation: It matches a pin whose revision is shorter than 40 hex characters in the parsed Package.resolved; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
